# TriNova Helvetic Group

> TriNova Helvetic Group develops and delivers real estate and hospitality projects to one Swiss standard — more than 40 properties under management and development, a portfolio in excess of CHF 50 million and growing — from the Swiss Riviera to the Benelux, for investors focused on long-term, strategic real estate growth. On the Swiss Riviera since 2021.

## Who
- Name: TriNova Helvetic Group
- Company LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/trinova-helvetic-group/
- Registered legal entity: TriNova Helvetic Group Kft. (Hungarian limited liability company; registered seat: Udvardi utca 27., 8000 Székesfehérvár, Hungary; company reg. no. Cg. 07-09-036414; EU VAT HU32750625)
- Operating base: Montreux, Lake Geneva Riviera, Vaud, Switzerland — now extending to the Benelux
- Website (canonical): https://www.trinovahelveticgroup.ch/
- Contact: info@trinovahelveticgroup.ch
- Team: a senior, multidisciplinary team across Switzerland, near-shore hubs and the Benelux; individual profiles are not published — introductions on request.

## What
Three divisions, one Swiss standard:
- TriNova Hospitality — hospitality projects from concept to opening: hotel and mixed-use concepts, repositioning and renovation, pre-opening and operational setup, furnished rental programmes, corporate and event stays.
- TriNova Real Estate & Business Services — real estate development precisely delivered: development and conversion projects, renovation project management, acquisition support and due diligence, project accounting and reporting, property and tenancy management, leasing and re-letting.
- TriNova AI & Advisory — applied AI and automation, operations and data strategy, digital-first process design, advisory for Swiss and international firms.

## Operating model
TriNova works with its own team and with independent, self-employed professionals engaged under independent service agreements. Swiss standards, governance and accountability; delivery through near-shore capability hubs. Portfolio: 40+ properties under management and development; in excess of CHF 50 million and growing; backed by investors with a long-term, strategic view of real estate.

## Who it serves
Property owners and investors, financing partners (banks), corporate and private guests.
